subject.title: docs: document embedded compaction context contracts

question: Should maintainers land this focused `result-fallback-classifier.ts` comment slice as the canonical replacement for the overlapping fallback-classifier docblock in `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89533`?
rationale: The code is comment-only and review-clean, but the protected `maintainer` label and overlapping source-comment PR require owner intent rather than cleanup automation.

options.title: Land Focused Slice
options.body: Merge this narrow comment-only PR after normal maintainer review, then treat the overlapping fallback-classifier portion of the broader PR as superseded.

options.title: Fold Into Broader PR
options.body: Ask the author to keep the fallback-classifier comments in the broader source-comment PR instead, accepting the larger conflict and drift surface.

options.title: Pause Source Comments
options.body: Keep both comment-only PRs unmerged if maintainers do not want durable inline contract prose for this helper right now.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Slice
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow comment-only PR after normal maintainer review, then treat the overlapping fallback-classifier portion of the broader PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored this focused PR, co-authored the current-main classifier-introduction commit, and posted the latest routing comment for the overlapping comment work.
